name: skill-steward
description: Engineering stewardship skills and repo-quality patterns for agent-operated repositories.

interface.longDescription: Skill Steward provides portable Agent Skills for charter, decisions, docs, quality gates, release legibility, handoff, and evidence-backed contract proof. This plugin exposes the skills only; hooks remain explicit manual opt-in through the repo's plugins directory.
defaultPrompt: Use Skill Steward to establish the smallest honest repo-quality contract for this repository.
Use Skill Steward to decide whether repeated repo friction belongs in docs, a check, a skill, a local script, or native tooling.
